rule: Only consider a persistent mean-gate discrepancy if the n16 disabled-capture control matches and both fixed-dt fine cases have standard PASS, reference-operator mean-gradient/curl PASS at every captured stage, and measured mean-quality FAIL at postSolve. Otherwise NOT_OBSERVED only if both pass all specified mean gates; incomplete/mixed evidence is UNCERTAIN. No upstream contract violation follows.
limits: This is an AMR mean-quality study; it does not replace the frozen N=4 uniform benchmark or its peak/spectrum gates.
Sampled peak discrepancies are diagnostics; continuous extrema and AMR spectra remain separate open obligations.
The thresholds are prospective but informed by earlier N=4 diagnostics; no blinded study or independent benchmark-design novelty is claimed.
Source equivalence of the whole packaged runtime is not established; instrumented module source is verified and its load is recorded.
Quality failure alone does not imply an implementation bug, singularity, molecular alignment, phase transition or viscosity change.
